Inspired by @karpathy, I built a "Second Brain" for myself.

The idea is simple: throw articles, papers, notes, and images into a knowledge base, let an LLM continuously organize it into a wiki, then access via CLI or a simple UX.

What surprised me is how different it feels from chat. Instead of constantly re-supplying context, the knowledge keeps accumulating and the answers keep improving.

For the first time, it feels like I'm building a long-term memory instead of a pile of bookmarks.

This 15-minute AI agent workflow can help run parts of your business for you:

(even if you are non-technical)

1. Open ChatGPT.

2. Create a Project called “My AI Assistant.”

3. Upload:
 your FAQs
  services/products
  SOPs
  brand voice notes
  pricing sheet
  sales scripts

4. Tell ChatGPT:
 “You are my AI operations assistant.”

5. Add instructions like:
 answer customer questions
  write emails
  draft proposals
  organize ideas
  summarize meetings
